formula: len(P), where P is the first 8192 code points of `path?query + " " + body`
notes: Name is historical; P is the request target plus body, not the body alone.

formula: -sum(p_i * log2(p_i)) over character frequencies in P, rounded half-up to 4 decimals
notes: Computed from the same character Counter used for the ratio features.

formula: count(c in P where c is not ASCII alphanumeric and not whitespace) / len(P), 4 decimals
notes: ASCII test is explicit; non-ASCII characters count as special.

formula: count(c in P where c is ASCII 0-9) / len(P), 4 decimals
count(c in P where c is ASCII A-Z) / len(P), 4 decimals
len(P.split()) using Python/JavaScript whitespace splitting
count of the 12 SQL keywords present in lower(P) + " " + unquote(P).lower()
notes: Keywords: select, union, drop, insert, delete, update, where, or 1=1, --, information_schema, sleep(, benchmark(.

formula: count of the 9 XSS keywords present in lower(P) + " " + unquote(P).lower()
notes: Keywords: <script>, javascript:, onerror=, onload=, eval(, alert(, document.cookie, <iframe, <svg.

formula: count of the 6 traversal patterns present in lower(P) + " " + unquote(P).lower()
1 if lower(User-Agent) contains any of 16 scanner names, else 0
notes: Names: sqlmap, nikto, nmap, masscan, gobuster, dirbuster, w3af, acunetix, havij, hydra, metasploit, botnet, zgrab, wpscan, censys, shodan.

formula: count of 7 regex patterns matching lower(P) + " " + unquote(P).lower()
notes: Separator+command, shell paths, /etc/ reads, curl/wget URLs, nc -e, $(command), and backtick command.

formula: total characters consumed by %XX, \xXX and \uXXXX matches / len(P), 4 decimals
1 if %00, \x00, \0 or a literal NUL is present in P, else 0
number of `key=` matches minus number of distinct keys, regex `(?<![A-Za-z0-9_.-])([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)=`
notes: Dropped in v4: exactly zero on CSIC 2010.

formula: count of opening HTML/XML/SVG tags / token_count, 4 decimals
notes: Dropped in v4: exactly zero on CSIC 2010.

formula: GET 0.1; POST 0.4; PUT 0.6; DELETE 0.6; PATCH 0.5; OPTIONS 0.2; HEAD 0.1; TRACE 1.0; CONNECT 0.8; default 0.5
1 if lower(path before ?) ends with one of 17 backup/config/source extensions, else 0
count of ', ", %27 and %22 in lower(P)
count of <, >, %3c and %3e in lower(P)
count of %25XX sequences in lower(P), regex `%25[0-9a-fA-F]{2}`
max over decoded query and form-body values of (non-alphanumeric, non-space characters / len(value)), 4 decimals
notes: JSON bodies yield no key=value pairs and therefore no values.

formula: max len(value) over decoded query and form-body values
notes: JSON bodies yield no key=value pairs and therefore no values.
